name: edge_event_capture_regs
desc: Edge event capture: enables, debounce, pending edges, counters, timestamp, interrupt enables.

registers.name: DEBOUNCE
registers.desc: clocks an input must be stable before its edge counts (0: none)

registers.name: RISE_PEND
registers.desc: rising edges seen per input; write 1 to clear

registers.name: FALL_PEND
registers.desc: falling edges seen per input; write 1 to clear

registers.name: EVENT_COUNT
registers.desc: clocks with at least one captured edge

registers.name: IRQ_EN
registers.desc: irq_o while a pending edge of an enabled input is set
